_comment: Outreach settings (design 7.5-7.7). Sending caps, warm-up and the send window are in caps.json; who the mailboxes are (addresses, SMTP passwords) is in the environment, never here. Changing anything in this file changes what founders receive, so it goes through review like code.

approval._comment: Design 7.5: every draft is approved by a person until the quality check agrees with the reviewers consistently; then a sample. mode 'sample' takes effect only with at least evidence.min_decisions reviewer decisions in evidence.window_days at evidence.min_agreement_pct agreement, and once a person records switched_on_by and switched_on_on. sample_pct of the drafts that pass the check still go to a person. See services/src/outreach/sampling.js and `lead-engine approval:agreement`.

campaigns._comment: Campus and other campaigns (services/src/public/campaigns.js): the landing page is PUBLIC_BASE_URL/j/<code>; visits, claims, sign-ups and payments from it are counted on Results. code: lower-case letters, digits and -; from and to are IST days (both optional); active false stops it. This one is an example, switched off.
campaigns.name: Example campus campaign

verification._comment: Checking an address before the first email (services/src/outreach/verify.js). use: results that may be emailed; hold: kept out of the first wave (accept-all domains, design 7.3) and written to in a second wave second_wave_after_days later, once the first wave's bounces are known; every other result is never used for that address (a different address found later, such as one on the company's website, is checked afresh). A verification service is optional: EMAIL_VERIFY_PROVIDER (zerobounce or millionverifier) and EMAIL_VERIFY_API_KEY; without one, addresses that pass the free checks are 'unverified' and used. A person's address (a founder's own Gmail, say) only ever gets the free checks: it is never sent to the service.

evidence._comment: What a message may mention. Only firm obligations (never conditional or ongoing ones), upcoming within deadline_window_days or due within the last past_window_days, and schemes whose verdict is eligible or check_required.

recipient._comment: Who a first email may go to. A company's registered email is published under the Companies Act (MCA master data); an address on the company's own website is published by the company. Anything else needs consent.
recipient._use_website_email: When on, a company with no registered email, or one whose registered email is a person's, is written to at the role address it publishes on its own website (found by `leadengine enrich websites`), and the email's last paragraph says so instead of naming the MCA register. Off until the lawyer has approved that wording (legal review pack, section 2).

drafting._comment: The AI drafter is used only when the LLM gateway is configured; otherwise, and whenever an AI draft fails the quality check twice, the reviewed templates in services/src/outreach/templates.js write the message.

quality._body_max_words_comment: Per kind, and per language where Hindi needs more words for the same text (postpositions are words of their own). Raised in Phase 4 from 230 for a first email: a full evidence pack (three dates, two schemes) makes the reviewed template 237 words in English and 260 in Hindi, which the old limit sent to the failed pile.
banned_phrases: ministry of corporate affairs has asked

page._comment: The company page and the unsubscribe link live behind unguessable links that expire.

claim._comment: claim-v2 (Phase 4) adds the call-back consent and says the number may be used for a call.

hindi._comment: The Hindi company page and claim form (services/src/public/i18n.js). A draft translation: served to founders only once a lawyer has reviewed it and approved_by and approved_on are filled in. Until then only a preview: add ?lang=hi&preview=1 to a company page link. Consents given in Hindi are recorded with this wording version.

reminders._comment: For founders who claimed their page and agreed to reminders: a reminder this many days before each confirmed, firm deadline, at most max_per_30_days per channel.

inbound._comment: Reading the outreach mailboxes (services/src/inbound/). Read-only (IMAP EXAMINE and BODY.PEEK). On the first run a mailbox is read from start_date or first_read_days ago, whichever is later; after that, from the last message read. A reply's label acts by itself only for an opt-out or a wrong address, at auto_act_confidence or above; the AI is asked only when the rules are below ai_below. Replies and their text are kept retention_days, then removed.

whatsapp._comment: Utility templates only, to numbers that opted in on the company page. Not before 09:00 or after 21:00 IST.
